quizName: DMV Practice Test #7 25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: Convex mirrors make cars look:

options.text: Larger.
Farther away.
Faster.
Narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Farther away.
questions.explanation: Convex mirrors show a wider view of the road than flat mirrors. However, they make objects appear farther away than they really are.

questions.question: Which of the following will NOT help prevent serious injury?

options.text: A DOT-approved helmet.
Face or eye protection.
Ear buds.
Protective clothing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ear buds.
questions.explanation: To protect yourself, wear a DOT-approved helmet, face or eye protection, a sturdy jacket and long pants, high boots or shoes that support your ankles, and durable gloves.

questions.question: What should you do if your drive chain is slipping?

options.text: Tighten the chain
Loosen the chain
Use the throttle more
Apply the rear brake

questions.correctAnswerText: Tighten the chain
questions.explanation: If your chain is slipping, try tightening it. If that does not fix the problem, replace the chain before riding again.

questions.question: In a group ride, inexperienced riders should be near the front because:

options.text: Experienced riders can watch them more easily.
They will get lost if they lead.
They may slow the group down as leaders.
They will ride too fast in any other position.

questions.correctAnswerText: Experienced riders can watch them more easily.
questions.explanation: Less experienced riders should ride near the front, just behind the leader. This lets experienced riders watch them easily.

questions.question: What type of material offers the best protection for motorcycle clothing?

options.text: Leather
Wool
Polyester
Silk

questions.correctAnswerText: Leather
questions.explanation: Leather clothing offers the best protection for motorcyclists. Always wear clothing that covers your arms and legs completely when riding.

questions.question: When braking, use:

options.text: The front brake only.
The rear brake only.
Both front and rear brakes.
Either the front or rear brake, but not both.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both front and rear brakes.
questions.explanation: Always use both brakes when you slow down or stop.

questions.question: Many over-the-counter drugs:

options.text: Make riding more dangerous.
Make riding safer.
Only affect riding if you drink alcohol at the same time.
Have the same effect on every person.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make riding more dangerous.
questions.explanation: Like alcohol, many drugs (including over-the-counter and prescription medications) can have side effects that make it unsafe to ride.

questions.question: When a group of riders passes another vehicle, they should:

options.text: Pass in a staggered formation.
Pass in a pyramid formation.
Pass one at a time.
Pass in a splintered formation.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pass one at a time.
questions.explanation: On a two-lane road, riders should pass one at a time. The second rider should wait until the first rider is safely back in the original lane before passing.

questions.question: Shifting to a lower gear has an effect similar to:

options.text: Accelerating.
Braking.
Swerving.
Turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: Braking.
questions.explanation: Most motorcycles have a manual transmission. Shifting to a lower gear slows you down.

questions.question: The only way to remove alcohol from your body is through:

options.text: Time.
Drinking coffee.
Exercising.
Taking a cold shower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Time.
questions.explanation: Your body needs time to remove alcohol. There are no shortcuts to becoming sober.

questions.question: A face shield should:

options.text: Give you a clear view to both sides.
Stop air from passing through it.
Be tight enough so glasses cannot fit underneath it.
Not fasten too tightly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give you a clear view to both sides.
questions.explanation: A good face shield must have no scratches, resist penetration, let you see clearly to both sides, fasten securely, allow air to pass through, and leave room for eyeglasses or sunglasses if needed.

questions.question: Which of the following will protect your eyes from the wind?

options.text: Goggles
Windshield
Sunglasses
Eyeglasses

questions.correctAnswerText: Goggles
questions.explanation: Goggles and face shields protect your eyes from wind. Windshields, eyeglasses, and sunglasses do not provide enough protection.

questions.question: When preparing to pass a vehicle on the left, ride on the left side of your lane because:

options.text: The right side could be slippery.
It gives you the best view of hazards in the next lane.
Drivers don't usually expect to be passed on their left.
It places you in the car's rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: It gives you the best view of hazards in the next lane.
questions.explanation: Riding on the left side of your lane improves your view ahead and makes you more visible to oncoming traffic.

questions.question: If a dog is chasing you, you should:

options.text: Kick it away.
Stop until the dog loses interest.
Swerve around the dog.
Approach it slowly, then speed up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach it slowly, then speed up.
questions.explanation: Dogs are often attracted to motorcycles. Downshift and approach the dog slowly. Then accelerate and ride away from it.

questions.question: An experienced rider:

options.text: Changes positions within their lane as conditions change.
Stays in one part of the lane at all times.
Weaves within the lane to be more visible.
Travels only on the oily part of the lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Changes positions within their lane as conditions change.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle rider has three lane position options. You should choose the safest position based on road and traffic conditions.

questions.question: To reduce your crash risk, do all of the following except:

options.text: Be visible by wearing proper clothing and using your headlight.
Signal your turns and use your brake light.
Look for hazards in your path.
Hope the other drivers see you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hope the other drivers see you.
questions.explanation: To stay safe, be visible to others, signal your intentions, keep space around you, and watch for hazards. Be ready to react to anything.

questions.question: When riding in a group and passing another vehicle, it is best to:

options.text: Let one rider fully pass before another rider begins to pass.
Let several riders pass the vehicle at once.
Have the last rider wave to signal no other motorcycles are coming.
Pass in a staggered formation.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let one rider fully pass before another rider begins to pass.
questions.explanation: In a group, riders should pass one at a time. Each rider should finish their pass and rejoin the group formation before the next rider passes.

questions.question: If a dog is chasing you, you should:

options.text: Kick it away.
Stop until the dog loses interest.
Swerve around the dog.
Approach it slowly, then speed up.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach it slowly, then speed up.
questions.explanation: If a dog chases you, downshift and slowly approach it. Then accelerate and ride away. Do not try to kick it.

questions.question: If your friend has been drinking, you should do all of the following except:

options.text: Arrange a safe ride home for your friend.
Keep your friend busy with other activities.
Keep your friend from leaving until they are sober.
Allow your friend to ride their motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Allow your friend to ride their motorcycle.
questions.explanation: To prevent an impaired friend from riding, arrange another way home, involve them in other activities, find excuses to keep them from leaving early, and ask other friends to help.

questions.question: When riding downhill or shifting into first gear, you may need to:

options.text: Use your brakes to slow down before downshifting.
Speed up before downshifting.
Swerve to the left.
Flash your brakes to tell drivers behind you that you are downshifting.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your brakes to slow down before downshifting.
questions.explanation: Before shifting to a lower gear, slow down to a safe speed. Downshifting too fast can cause the motorcycle to lurch and the rear wheel to skid.

questions.question: How should you sit on a motorcycle to control it properly?

options.text: Sit so your arms steer the motorcycle, not hold you up.
Sit far back on the seat so your arms stay straight.
Keep your knees away from the gas tank.
Drag your feet on the ground.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sit so your arms steer the motorcycle, not hold you up.
questions.explanation: Sit so your arms control the motorcycle instead of holding you up. Your arms should be slightly bent at the handlebars. Keep your knees against the gas tank and your feet firmly on the footrests to maintain balance.

questions.question: Which is NOT a requirement for an effective eye or face shield?

options.text: It must fasten securely.
It must be too tight to wear sunglasses or eyeglasses.
It must be free of scratches.
It must allow clear side views.

questions.correctAnswerText: It must be too tight to wear sunglasses or eyeglasses.
questions.explanation: An effective eye or face shield must be free of scratches, fasten securely, allow clear side views, prevent fogging, and have room for eyeglasses or sunglasses if needed.

questions.question: Which sign is rectangular in shape?

options.text: School crossing sign.
Railroad crossing sign.
Stop sign.
Speed limit sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed limit sign.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs like speed limits are rectangular and white with black lettering. Riders must follow all rules posted on regulatory signs.

questions.question: When carrying a passenger in a sidecar, what should you do?

options.text: Start slowing down earlier than usual.
Start slowing down later than usual.
Brake harder than usual to stop quickly.
Brake softly to avoid overworking the brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Start slowing down earlier than usual.
questions.explanation: The extra weight of a sidecar passenger affects how your motorcycle handles. Your motorcycle will need more distance to stop.

questions.question: What color is a warning sign?

options.text: Yellow with black lettering or symbols
Blue with white lettering or symbols
White with black lettering or symbols
Red with white lettering or symbols

questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow with black lettering or symbols
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They alert drivers to upcoming road conditions.
